steps.instruction: Read the request and prior authority. Write a plain-language restatement that quotes the supplied promise verbatim and ask for explicit confirmation before any model work. If corrected, bind the corrected promise in a new request revision.

calls.purpose: Read the request and prior authority.
Persist the exact restatement awaiting confirmation.

steps.instruction: Inspect backend evidence at the frozen head after confirmation. Separate intent, fact, assumption and contradiction claims. Bind each fact to role, path, line range and head; architecture may inform feasibility but never business behavior.

reads.when: when architecture or prior authority evidence is declared

calls.purpose: Verify the cited backend head without mutation.

steps.instruction: Model only the confirmed promise. Give each declared dimension and discovered consumer one disposition and supporting claim, including separate legacy create, read and settle paths. Block on missing consumers, not-applicable mandatory dimensions or unresolved contradictions.

calls.purpose: Resolve one named public business evidence gap without treating it as source truth.
calls.when: only when the request explicitly permits public evidence

steps.instruction: Under an exclusive lease, compare the prior head again, construct a legal pending, in-progress or rejected model with exact claim and coverage fingerprints, archive it by content address, and update only this feature head. If the desired content is already published, reuse it without a duplicate write.

writes.when: only when the immutable object is absent

calls.purpose: Re-read the prior head under the publication lease.
Archive and publish the accepted business model atomically within declared authority.
calls.when: only after every prior criterion passes

steps.instruction: Write the authority receipt and response from the accepted artifacts. Validate exact bindings and state limits. Do not claim implementation, quality or UAT success.

calls.purpose: Run scripts/validate_operator.py for this bundle and records.
Present the accepted authority or concrete blocker.
